description_en: Queries the trace of a message. If a message is not sent or received as expected, you can call this operation to view the message details to troubleshoot the issue. For example, you can query the time when the message is published and the client that publishes the message
description_zh: 查询指定消息的发送轨迹。当消息的收发不符合预期时，您可以通过该接口查看消息的发布时间、发布客户端等详细信息，帮助您快速定位异常原因
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt query-mqtt-trace-message-publish --mqtt-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id mqtt-cn-i7m26mf0000 --msg-id AC1EC0030EAB78308DB16A3EC7730000 --begin-time 1618646400000 --end-time 1621591200000 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMqttTraceMessagePublish

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例地域（Region）的ID。请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.name: mqtt_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. The ID must be consistent with the ID of the instance that the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client uses. You can view the instance ID in the Basic Information section on the Instance Details page that corresponds to the instance in the ApsaraMQ for MQTT console
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台实例详情页面的基础信息区域查看
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time
